items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1967-02-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I mean, I think along those lines, you have the Sam Morgan Band, Jim Robson recorded in the 20s, and Louis Domaine's band recorded. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I know.

ctx.x: The style was the same because he got all the old musicians to play that style, like George Lewis and his guitar player. His old man used to play bass. What's his name? Schlerdragpa? No, no, no, Morera. Lawrence Morera. Yeah, I know his brother John and Simon were the two greatest string men we had. He played with the Young Olympia Band in 17, 18, 19 and 20 like that. Morera was a kid. He was a little younger than I am. He was small. His old man was a hell of a bass player. And when they got this band for Bunk,…
I mean, I think along those lines, you have the Sam Morgan Band, Jim Robson recorded in the 20s, and Louis Domaine's band recorded.
